name: sentimony
description: Sentimony agent skills as installable Claude Code and Codex plugins: agentflow from sentimony/agentic-workflow, skills from sentimony/skills, and cross-agent from sentimony/cross-agent.

plugins.name: agentflow
plugins.description: Agentic workflow skills for one change from request to merge: specify the design, craft the plan, implement it, verify with evidence, request and resolve an independent code review, finalize the branch, and record session learnings.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Sentimony agent skills: scope triage, planning, plan execution, test-driven development, debugging, code review, verification, and branch finishing; prose editing, dashes, and negative parallelism; skill crafting; Apache ECharts; frontend design, Vitest, TypeScript, agent context maintenance, secret hygiene, browser debugging, GitHub account switching, and committing the working tree.

plugins.name: cross-agent
plugins.description: Delegate consultations and installed skills to explicitly configured agent CLIs with persistent task and provider session identities.
